searchText: How is the date for Glamsterdam looking btw? I'm hearing end of Oct, I'm hearing a month or two after live on Hoodi. Any soft indication? Partners keep asking us 😅 . General point: people might give a "soft indication". Nothing anyone says right now is binding and referring back to it as some kind of betrayal if it's not fulfilled will not be sound reasoning There are agreements about relative time periods to when the testnets go out, for purposes of people testing/deploying, yeah
